newsitem.title: UK: Shell cancels Jan 15-17 Brent cargo - trade.
newsitem.headline: Shell cancels Jan 15-17 Brent cargo - trade.

text.p: Brent system operator Shell UK on Monday cancelled a cargo due to load Jan 15-17, traders said.
"The request for the cargo to be cancelled came from the Brent field system coordination unit," said a Shell UK official, without offering further details.
Traders said they were not aware of any production problems on the Brent or Ninian systems, which together make up world benchmark Brent Blend crude loaded at Sullom Voe.
Earlier this month, Shell set the January Brent loading programme at 44 standard 500,000-barrel cargoes and 1.509 million barrels in smaller top-up cargoes.

Two Brent cargoes were nominated loading dates of Jan 14-16 on Monday. One was kept by the equity holder Esso while the other, brought forward a day by equity holder Elf, was clocked to U.S.-based trader Cargill, traders said.
